entities.summary: Amy Hunt is a British sprinter who won silver in the 4 x 100 m at the 2024 Summer Olympics and silver in the 200 m at the 2025 World Athletics Championships. She holds the world record for the women's under-18 200 metres, set in June 2019 with a time of 22.42s.
